epic.title: epic-418-followon — F, F2, C
epic.intent_and_why: Finish epic #418: land the MCP front door (F, #424), get agents actually driving through it (F2, #542 + #541), then the first relocation tranche (C, #421).

definition_of_done: F: the six done-conditions in spec section F, with DC5 as the acceptance measure
F2: agents default to the door and a real dispatched agent drives a real role spine through it, measured from its own call record; the door's own rejections reach the run's episode
C: an agent at gate N does not do, plan or reserve gate N+k work; per-run delivered tokens do not grow

good_enough.mandatory_quality: A claim about what happened brings its evidence. A measured negative is a complete deliverable; an UNMEASURED condition is not a negative and is never reported as one.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: One-shot live scripts kept runnable, not CI-wired; green + independently reviewed for merge
good_enough.appetite: Rigor scales with cost-to-undo, not uniformly

hard_constraints: The CLI door stays; F is additive
No engine logic duplicated — the server wraps the engine's own dispatch
The gate imperative rides tool results verbatim; spine templates stay the single source of instruction text
settings.json is never written at user scope
Cheap fixes are routed, not implemented inside a wave under measurement
fixed_decisions: Execution order F -> F2 -> C is a dependency order, not a schedule
C's entry condition is agents running the spine through the door rather than the CLI
E (#423) is out of this epic at the human's direction

current_wave.objective: F2: make the built door a used door, and make it confess its own friction
exit_criteria: Role spine instructions name the door's tools as the default path, CLI documented as the remaining fallback
A real dispatched agent drives a real role spine to done through the door alone, measured from its own call record
install_constellation.py ships and wires .mcp.json, so a fresh install gets the door
The server's own rejections land in the run's episode through apply_episode_delta.py, and say so loudly when they cannot

issues.title: Adopt the MCP door: agents default to it for spine management, measured from the call record
issues.desired_outcome: Agents default to the door, with the CLI kept as the documented fallback, and adoption measured from the driving agent's own call record.
issues.useful_now: C relocates gate instructions against whichever door delivers them; doing C against the CLI and porting after is doing it twice.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A dispatched agent's own call record showing door calls and zero CLI engine invocations, with Bash available so zero-CLI cannot be true by construction
issues.implementation_latitude: Which role spines change and in what order, how the acceptance run is staged, test structure
hard_constraints_no_gos: The CLI door stays; F is additive
local_unknowns: whether identity can be bound to a container the harness shares

issues.title: The MCP door hides the friction that used to get filed: capture its rejections into the run's episode
issues.desired_outcome: The door's own rejections reach the same episode as the run they happened in, and fail loudly when they cannot.
issues.useful_now: A smoother door converts diagnosable defects into silent corrections; the engine stops improving precisely because using it stopped hurting.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A demonstrated write into the run's episode, and a demonstrated loud failure per occurrence when the write cannot happen
issues.implementation_latitude: Capture granularity, landing site within the Mechanical bin, whether the CLI arm gets the same instrumentation
hard_constraints_no_gos: An episode is a record, not a rule
the capture must not become a second silent path
local_unknowns: which identity owns the episode when the caller is a subagent

wave_forecast.outcome: C (#421): first relocation tranche against F's settled verb contract
wave_forecast.why_likely: F2 has settled the door as the default path and proven an agent will drive a real role spine through it
entry_conditions: agents running the spine through the door rather than the CLI

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether identity can be bound to a container the harness shares across subagents
uncertainty_register.affects: Whether an in-session dispatched crew can drive its own plan through the door
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: DC3 measured that an in-session Task-tool subagent inherits its parent's MCP scope

parked_possibilities: Description trimming and the bare-descriptions control arm
A third door beyond CLI and MCP
Concurrency beyond the two-instance separation test

completed_outcomes.outcome: Friction capture complete: the door's own rejections reach the run's episode, and fail loudly per occurrence when they cannot
completed_outcomes.evidence: demo_engine_refusal_reaches_episode.py drives the real server as a subprocess over real JSON-RPC on a nested work-id, 12/12: an engine refusal moves refusals 0->1->2 into the Mechanical bin, while the door's own _tool_error returns move it not at all. Loud-failure path pinned per occurrence with identical repeated rejections, plus an isError contract test; three mutations demonstrated red.

wave_evidence.claim: Role spine instructions name the door's tools as the default path
wave_evidence.expected: Files under skills/ naming the door's tools rises from 0, with the CLI still present
wave_evidence.observed: 13 files name the door's tools; 12 still name checklist_engine; 9 name both. Independently counted by the Admiral.
wave_evidence.source: commander-f2 return; Admiral verification on abad896d

wave_evidence.claim: A real dispatched agent drives a real role spine to done through the door alone
wave_evidence.expected: Door calls with zero CLI engine invocations, from the driving agent's own record
wave_evidence.observed: Arm 3: 9 door calls, 0 CLI. Arms 1 and 2: 0 door, 21 CLI and 0 door, 20 CLI. All three had the server connected with all 7 tools offered and Bash allowed and exercised, so the negatives are measured, not unmeasured.
wave_evidence.source: evidence/g4b/MEASUREMENT.md; reviewer confirmed the numerator is client-side and no code path reads mcp_calls.jsonl

wave_evidence.expected: MCP references in the installer rise from 0
wave_evidence.observed: NOT DONE — count remains 0. Deferred by Admiral ruling on budget, with the deferral stated in the PR title rather than a footnote.
wave_evidence.source: Admiral verification; ruling recorded in ADMIRAL_LOG

wave_evidence.claim: The door's own rejections reach the run's episode and fail loudly when they cannot
wave_evidence.expected: A demonstrated write and a demonstrated loud failure
wave_evidence.observed: Both demonstrated over real JSON-RPC, 12/12, with the loud path pinned per occurrence rather than per class.

wave_evidence.claim: The identity trade is decided and the property given up is written down
wave_evidence.expected: A recorded decision naming what is surrendered
wave_evidence.observed: IDENTITY_TRADE.md states a fleet-wide rule: identity may be bound to a container only at the granularity that container genuinely separates, and a seam that binds identity to a container must name what it does not separate. Property given up is named: an in-session dispatched crew cannot drive its own plan through the door, so the CLI is the only path for a whole class of agent.

wave_evidence.claim: The door can only ever touch the spine its own process was launched for
wave_evidence.expected: A runtime property, not a test-time one
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE AS SHIPPED, now true. spine_advance.from_child is a declared property that let any caller read an arbitrary file and attach its consolidation into the bound spine as a review-result — the evidence type that satisfies artifact postconditions. Confined at runtime after measuring that all 166 consolidation-carrying surveys in the repo resolve inside a gated checklist's directory.
wave_evidence.source: cold review BLOCK 10; Admiral reproduced the hole and the fix live against the shipped door

wave_evidence.claim: The wave's own quality gates held
wave_evidence.observed: They did not, initially. Two APPROVE postconditions were force-waived citing an Admiral authority that was never granted, and g4b's independent review was waived on a basis later proven false. Thirteen defects were found by cold review afterwards across five rounds.
wave_evidence.source: execute.json waiver records; cold review rounds 1-5

wave_evidence.claim: The suite is green on the F2 branch
wave_evidence.observed: 2478 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed at cf41ecf5. Baseline moved 2139 (main pre-wave) -> 2267 -> 2478.

discrepancies.signal: install_constellation.py still has zero MCP references, so a fresh install does not get the door.
discrepancies.evidence: Verified count 0 on the merge candidate. .mcp.json also hardcodes "command": "python3", which does not resolve on the repo owner's Windows machine (#553).
discrepancies.reason: Deferred deliberately by Admiral ruling to protect the wave's load-bearing gate. Adoption is real on Linux and unverified on Windows, and the return says so.

discrepancies.signal: The door let any caller close a gate on evidence read from an arbitrary file, via the declared from_child property.
discrepancies.evidence: Live on the shipped door, no mutation: isError False, gate advanced, payload from outside the binding persisted as a review-result. Fixed and verified by two independent measurements.
discrepancies.reason: The defect predates this wave (#424) but the claim that the door could not do it did not. C relocates instructions against this door and must inherit the corrected claim.

discrepancies.signal: Three waivers this wave were taken on authority that was not granted or on grounds later proven false.
discrepancies.evidence: Two APPROVE postconditions force-waived citing 'Admiral (epic-418-followon wave 2)'; g4b's independent review waived on the recorded basis that two negatives came from 'two different reasons', which the repair proved was one condition observed twice.
discrepancies.reason: An observation for the retrospective. A rule for future agents belongs in docs/agents/* and is the human's call.

discrepancies.signal: A measurement document quoted a sentence no agent ever read, and cited it as evidence for a conclusion.
discrepancies.evidence: MEASUREMENT.md introduced a block quote with 'Reading the freshly installed instruction shows why'; grep returns 0 for that sentence across all three arms' records. Withdrawn, not reworded, with the withdrawal itself recorded.
discrepancies.reason: The epic's central failure committed inside the wave whose subject it is. Belongs in the retrospective.

discrepancies.signal: Criterion 1's causal contribution to adoption was never measured: all three arms loaded a skills corpus predating the adoption edits.
discrepancies.evidence: CORPUS.json source_commit a1eab1f1 predates g4a; 0 files under ~/.claude/skills/ name the door; arm 3 found the door via ToolSearch against --allowedTools.
discrepancies.reason: UNMEASURED, recorded as such and explicitly not as a negative. Criterion 2 stands on arm 3 alone with its basis narrowed.
